import pandas as pd
def order_features(cutoff):
    c=pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
    act=active_at(c).set_index('client_id')
    f=pd.DataFrame(index=act.index)
    past=orders[(orders.order_date<=c)&(orders.status!='отменён')]
    recent=past[past.order_date>c-pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    f['orders_90']=recent.groupby('client_id').size().reindex(f.index,fill_value=0)
    f['revenue_90']=recent.groupby('client_id').amount.sum().reindex(f.index,fill_value=0)
    last=past.groupby('client_id').order_date.max().reindex(f.index)
    f['days_since_order']=(c-last).dt.days.fillna((c-act.start_date).dt.days)
    return f
feat=order_features('2026-06-30')
means=feat.mean().round(3).to_dict()
print(feat.shape,means)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
c=pd.Timestamp('2025-12-31')
auc_honest=round(roc_auc_score(test.churn,test.days_since_order),3)
valid=orders[orders.status!='отменён']
last=valid.groupby('client_id').order_date.max()
ids=test['client_id'] if 'client_id' in test.columns else test.index
latest=pd.Series(ids).map(last)
days=(c-latest).dt.days.fillna(0)
auc_leaky=round(roc_auc_score(test.churn,days),3)
n_future=int((valid.order_date>c).sum())
print(auc_honest,auc_leaky,n_future)
